why: The goal names the button, the page and what it downloads, the details say who it is for and the columns, and each criterion can be checked by clicking.

contract.title: Export the shown orders as CSV
contract.goal: Add an Export CSV button to the Orders page of the Pebblewick shop admin that downloads the orders the page is showing.
contract.details: The shop's two staff copy orders into a spreadsheet by hand every Friday. The file has one row per order with the columns order number, date, customer name and total, in that order. The page's date filter applies to the file too.

criteria.text: The Orders page shows an Export CSV button above the table.
Clicking the button downloads a CSV file with one row for each order the page shows and the four columns in the order given.
With the date filter set to one week, the file holds only that week's orders.
